claim_boundary: Candidate Stage-A threshold arms derived from silver development evidence. No arm is canonical until independent holdout and cluster-dropout evidence pass.

zero_dropout_candidate.development_role: best development F1 with zero observed silver useful-data dropout

low_dropout_candidate.development_role: best development F1 under 0.05 observed silver useful-data dropout

moderate_dropout_candidate.development_role: best development F1 under 0.10 observed silver useful-data dropout

high_recall_candidate.development_role: high-recall diagnostic under 0.15 observed silver useful-data dropout

selection_rule_after_holdout: Reject any candidate with holdout useful-data dropout above 0.05.
Among remaining candidates, require holdout precision at least 0.98.
Prefer the highest holdout near-only recall.
Do not promote without cluster-level representative-dropout evidence.
